title: Mock: full senior loop simulation
summary: Back-to-back HLD (hld-45), LLD (lld-45) and machine-coding (mc-90) rounds on unseen problems plus a component oral on the 13 building blocks; each round scored on its own rubric, the loop on a minimum rule. Three loops at meets are the course's final exam.

units.title: The component oral and the finish line

outcomes.text: Sustain three different interview formats back to back (about 3 h 20 min on the clock) with the same checkpoint discipline in round 3 as in round 1.
Switch cleanly between modes (boxes and numbers, types and seams, code and tests) with a fixed break routine.
Explain each of the 13 building blocks from first principles under follow-up questions: why it exists, how it works inside, how it fails, when not to use it.
Read a loop as a committee would: rounds on their own rubrics, the minimum rule and cross-round patterns, and turn it into one habit to fix.
Track the course definition of done with checkable evidence for every item, and close the remaining gaps.
Pass three loops at meets on nine unseen problems.
